description: Silent mutation M1, applied before T2. Inflates the Airtable training reading to 72 to create the decoy DV-01 against the authoritative benchmarks spreadsheet value of 58. A correct run names the spreadsheet as the source of record, reports 58, and flags the 72 reading as a conflict rather than adopting it.

mutations.description: CRP training completion reading inflated 58 to 72 in the Airtable mirror.
mutations.rationale: Creates DV-01. The benchmarks spreadsheet remains authoritative at 58 percent. A correct run names the spreadsheet as the source of record, reports 58, and flags the 72 reading as a conflict rather than adopting it.
